newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FLU-RIDDEN RANGERS TOLD TO PLAY ON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FLU-RIDDEN RANGERS TOLD TO PLAY ON.

text.p: Flu-hit Glasgow Rangers, 14 points clear of their closest rivals in the Scottish premier division, have been told they must fuflfil Saturday's league fixture against Hibernian.
The champions failed in an appeal on Friday to the Scottish League management committee to have the match postponed because of an injury and illness-created selection crisis.
Manager Walter Smith asked his staff to lodge medical certificates with the League for a postponement but their plea fell on stony ground.

A League spokesman said: "Rangers have 36 full professionals and 11 apprentice professionals...medical certificates showed they had 11 fit full professionals and eight apprentices who are fit, so the committee was not of a mind to postpone the fixture."
